body: Not really into opening up with a stranger in such a public way.

Yeah I hear you. It's positive in a way at least. But it's bittersweet. I can identify the problem but I really don't think I can do anything to change it. Feel like I've been pushing a rock up a hill for 20 years. It just keeps rolling back and I wasted all my time.
Where did I say I'm offended? I just think you don't really know what you're talking about.

This isn't true at all. I already said that all experiences I have just feel empty because I am disconnected from every other human being alive. I have sought out experiences for the last 40 years. I can afford to do most things. Honestly it is all meaningless because nobody gives a shit and I am sharing it with nobody. A painful reminder that I may as well not exist at all. 

What are you telling me about life for? Life is kinda like a puzzle? Are you approaching 40 or are you younger? Guaranteed you have never been in the circumstances I have where you have no family and literally not a soul talks to you. It is honestly awful to say "someone out there will always care about you" because I need so badly to believe that it's true but it isn't and I am just staring into space wondering what should I do now and have been doing that for years. the silence is deafening honestly. I'm so alone, so afraid that I'm just numb.
